title: fix(plugin-calendar, plugin-map, plugin-gantt): registration inputs agree with the record-source rule
body:
Fixes #10392
Fixes #10394
Clause-②: no — registration metadata stops contradicting a schema rule that has already landed, and the registrations declare two inputs the schema already accepts. No schema, export or accept set moves.

Folded family. Each commit belongs to one card, and the commit subject names its package: objectui#10392 (chain head, calendar) and objectui#10394 (map and gantt). Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM; this run's session is `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`.

## What changed

**objectui#10392, calendar.** `OBJECT_CALENDAR_INPUTS` (spread into both `object-calendar` and `calendar`) declared `{ name: 'objectName', type: 'string', required: true }`, while `ObjectCalendarSchema` carries `requireRecordSource('object-calendar')`. The flag is gone and the description states the rule, in the exact form PR objectui#10390 used for map and gantt: "ObjectQL object name. The record source is one of `data`, `staticData` and `objectName`; the `object-calendar` schema refuses a block that declares none of them." One edit covers both tags because the list is shared.

**objectui#10394, map and gantt.** `object-map`, `map` and `object-gantt` now declare `data` and `staticData`, on the schema's own arms:

- `data` is `type: 'object'`. `ObjectMapSchema.data` / `ObjectGanttSchema.data` are `ViewDataSchema`, a `{ provider, … }` object, and both renderers call the ladder on the `view-data` arm. So a bare array under `data` now draws `type-mismatch` in the html tier, which matches what the schema and the renderer already do with it.
- `staticData` is `type: 'array'`.

Each description says only what the renderer was measured to do (see the behaviour rows below). One map-specific limitation is published: the `api` provider is not implemented in `ObjectMap` and plots nothing.

`map` is declared exactly like `object-map`, and both keys spell the list inline. objectui#10393 is serial after this PR and may retire the bare `map` key. That is not decided here.

## Measured before writing the prose (hypotheses)

- **H1.** The flagged line is in the shared `OBJECT_CALENDAR_INPUTS`, so both calendar tags had it. There is no second copy. `data` / `staticData` were already declared there.
- **H2.** Both renderers read `data`, then `staticData`, then `objectName` through `resolveRecordSourceConfig(schema, 'view-data')`. This was probed through the real `SchemaRenderer` on all three keys, and the probe results are now committed as behaviour rows. Differences from the calendar:
  - map/gantt `data` is a provider configuration, not a record array.
  - On the map, `{ provider: 'api' }` plots nothing and logs `API provider not yet implemented for ObjectMap`. With `staticData` beside it, `staticData` is still not reached.
  - On the gantt, `api` reads through its request.
  - The descriptions were written from these readings.
- **H3.** Pins exist for both cards and are shown red on the base (below).
- **H4.** `map` has not been retired or re-armed.

## Tests

New pins:

- `packages/plugin-calendar/src/__tests__/recordSourceInput-10392.test.ts`
- `packages/plugin-map/src/index.recordSourceInputs-10394.test.tsx`
- `packages/plugin-gantt/src/__tests__/recordSourceInputs-10394.test.tsx`

What the pins check:

- Declaration rows, per key:
  - The html tier accepts a `staticData`-only node and a `data`-only node with zero diagnostics. That means no `missing-required-prop` on the calendar and no `unknown-prop` on map/gantt.
  - The declared arm equals the schema's arm, with the refused spelling as the control.
  - Each description names the position it is true about.
- Controls:
  - A bogus key is still reported. This node is bound by `objectName`, so the row holds on both trees.
  - `ObjectCalendarSchema` refuses a block with no record source (`RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED`) and accepts the `staticData`-only block.
  - Both map keys publish identical lists.
- Behaviour rows (map/gantt, through `SchemaRenderer`):
  - `data` wins over `staticData` and `objectName`.
  - `staticData` wins over `objectName` and issues no query.
  - An `object` provider queries its own object.
  - A bare array under `data` is not a record source.
  - Map: the `api` provider plots nothing. Gantt: the `api` provider fetches its URL.

All runs below are on the final head `9a2afd981`, the last commit of this PR:

- **Red on the base.** The three `index.tsx` files were checked out at the pinned base `557abc2f4`, with the tests left at HEAD. Markers were counted on disk after the mutation:
  - calendar `required: true` = 1;
  - map `name: 'staticData'` = 0;
  - gantt `name: 'staticData'` = 0.

  Result: `Tests 23 failed | 26 passed (49)`. This matches the direction predicted before running:
  - every declaration row went red;
  - every control, schema row, list-equality row and behaviour row stayed green.

  Failure reasons: `expected [ 'missing-required-prop' ] to not include 'missing-required-prop'` on the calendar, and `has no prop "staticData"` on the map and gantt.
- **Restore.** The files were restored with `git checkout HEAD -- path` under a trap. Proof: each blob hash matches `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Green on the head.** `Tests 49 passed (49)`.
- **Affected suites and registry readers.** `Test Files 156 passed (156)`, `Tests 1977 passed (1977)`. The run covered:
  - `packages/plugin-calendar/`, `packages/plugin-map/` and `packages/plugin-gantt/`;
  - the eight `apps/console` tests that enumerate the whole registry;
  - `calendar-flat-color-allday-8466`, `calendar-doc-key-set-8830` and `component-input-retired-keys-7493` in `packages/types`;
  - two `examples/schema-catalog` record-source render tests.
- **Type-check.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/PKG type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0 for `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-map` and `plugin-gantt`, after building their 15-package dependency closure. `--listFiles` confirms that each new pin is in its package's test program. The first type-check run caught TS7006 on an untyped mock-call parameter in the two map/gantt pins, and that was corrected in the last commit.

ESLint (`--no-inline-config --format json`) over the 7 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files gave 7 results, 0 errors, and warnings only, of kinds the files already carry (`no-explicit-any`, `only-export-components`). The config has no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot change a verdict on an untouched file.

NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`. Reason: it needs every package's `dist/index.d.ts`, and only the dependency closure was built, so it exits 1 with `self-import(s) could not be judged`. That is a prerequisite miss, not a verdict. The README edit changes no import or export line. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the rest of the CI farm are left to CI.

## Surface beyond the claim, and why

- `packages/plugin-gantt/README.md`: its sentence "It declares two inputs" became false with this change. It now names four inputs and says that `data` is a provider configuration.
- `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx`: this is a comment-only change. The `getDataConfig` docblock said the registration "declares no `data` input", which became false. It now says the registration declares `data` on the same object arm.
- `packages/plugin-map/package.json`, `packages/plugin-gantt/package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`: the new pins import `validateTree` from `@object-ui/sdui-parser`, which neither package declared, so `check:phantom-deps` was red. It is now a devDependency, as in `plugin-calendar` and `plugin-kanban`. The lockfile change is the two importer entries only.

## Acceptance notes

- `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only) gains three rows: `plugin-map:object-map.staticData`, `view:map.staticData` and `plugin-gantt:object-gantt.staticData`, each "outside (spec ∪ renderer reads)". The cause is that the static reader does not follow the shared ladder in `@object-ui/core` (`resolveRecordSourceConfig`), which is where `staticData` is read. The behaviour rows above show the read. The earlier `object-map.map` / `view:map.map` rows are unchanged.
  - An intermediate commit spread one shared map list into both registrations. That hid both registrations from this reader (its "cannot name" count went from 22 to 24), so the lists are spelled inline again and the count is 22, the same as on the base.
- After this change, `validateTree` no longer reports a calendar that has no record source at all. Before, it did so only through the `objectName` requiredness. The zod refinement is the only enforcement now. This is the same accepted trade the objectui#7470 ruling made for map and gantt: no one-of vocabulary in `inputs`.
- The calendar's `objectName` description says "the `object-calendar` schema refuses". That is true of `ObjectCalendarSchema` in `@object-ui/types`, which the pin measures. The spec face `ComponentPropsMap['object-calendar']` (on `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0) parses an empty object, so the refusal lives in this repo's mirror and not in the spec row.

## Findings for the seat (not filed here)

- class (b): `ObjectMapSchema.data` is `ViewDataSchema`, which accepts the `api` arm (`{ provider: 'api', read, write }`). `ObjectMap` does not implement it: the map logs `API provider not yet implemented for ObjectMap`, plots nothing, and still shadows `staticData`. This is pinned as a gap in `index.recordSourceInputs-10394.test.tsx`.
  - `Seam: spec:ObjectMapSchema.data (ViewData api arm) → renderer:ObjectMap fetch effect`.
  - The `schema` arm (`{ provider: 'schema', … }`) on either renderer is NOT MEASURED.
  - Dedupe words: ObjectMap api provider not implemented · object-map data provider api · map ViewData api arm.
- class (a): `packages/plugin-map/README.md` says that "`staticData`, a bare array under `data`, and `data: { provider: 'value', items }` all reach the same in-memory adapter". A bare array under `data` reaches nothing. Through `SchemaRenderer` it is neither a record source nor spread as a prop. On the host-prop path it is drawn without the adapter's filter. The failing probes are the "a bare array under data is not a record source" row here and the retirement rows in `ObjectMap.schemaDataShorthand.test.tsx`.
  - Dedupe words: plugin-map README bare array data · map README inline providers filter · bare array under data map.
  - Possible carrier: objectui#10393, which is next in `plugin-map` and edits its registration section.
